readerContract.humanQuestion: What protections can a US school request for education AI, and which tools remain outside this agreement?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Know what a US school must request, which education AI is covered, and why privacy promises do not prove learning value or correct answers.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No procurement, training or telemetry vocabulary assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: The protection follows the specific product and school agreement; it does not follow the company name everywhere.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A parent or teacher may be asked to trust an AI school assignment without knowing where the conversation goes.

readerContract.desiredFeeling: I can ask which product and terms cover this school assignment.

candidateRepairPreflight.data: Anonymous telemetry differs from covered identifiable data; no generative training permitted for telemetry.
candidateRepairPreflight.limits: No accuracy guarantee, certification-completion claim or all-company signature claim.
candidateRepairPreflight.distinct: School agreement is distinct from public MAI consultation.

draftArchitecture.openingJob: School agreement scope first; dates separate.
causalSequence: A US school requests applicable terms.
Only primarily education-designed AI is covered.
Covered identifiable data cannot feed general model training; safety processing has narrow limits.
Anonymous operational telemetry has separate permitted uses.
Privacy commitment does not establish accurate answers or teaching value.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: An AI tutoring assignment needs its own product-and-agreement check; a general work assistant used by a teacher is not covered simply because Microsoft supplies it.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A school subscription does not extend these terms to every app with the same vendor name.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Ask which exact product is being assigned and whether the school incorporated these standards into its agreement.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: The Story; LAiDIES Read; What This Means for You; Cocktail Party; Class Notes.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No legal checklist, product list, sweeping AI-in-school moral or decorative nostalgia.

discoveryChecks.question: Does a school Microsoft subscription cover every Microsoft app?
discoveryChecks.answer: No. The signed definition excludes general-purpose products even when schools license them.

discoveryChecks.question: Does privacy compliance prove correct answers?
discoveryChecks.answer: No. The agreement requires notices that AI outputs can be incorrect.
